Re-run reproduces on base and head (tests 6 and 7 fail, all five LIVENESS pass); the fixture's detach_dispatched_oid stamp matches what retire() writes after a successful _dispatch_detach (install.sql 3963) and passes _detach_dispatched. Distinct from #1259 (unvouched mark, dispatch failed, hand detach) and #705 (trusting pgpm.part.attached): here the mark is backed by its record and the detach is pgpm's own.
